last_episode_to_air.overview: After the attack they suffered after the wedding, all the Soykans, especially Aslan, are tested with great pain. While Aslan takes action to find Ferman; Hülya, wants to make Kıymet pay for what she did to her family. Devin will be the one who guides her for this purpose. On the other hand, a risky period begins in Devin's pregnancy. As the pregnancy progresses, the risk to life for Devin and her baby increases. As Devin faces the possibility of her child growing up without a mother; she enters into a preparation that she keeps as a secret from everyone. Aslan, on the other hand, takes his breath with him when he cannot reach Devin. However, he will encounter something he never expected. What is this big secret that Devin is keeping from everyone? The whole family gathers together. A big surprise that night will lead Aslan and Devin to their biggest fight. Will Aslan and Devin be able to establish their own family, for which they fought so hard, and end their story with a happy ending?
